SBI Clerk JA Backlog Pre Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : State Bank of India (SBI) has released the admit card for the Post of Junior Associates Clerk. This recruitment was released for 1538 posts. Applications for the SBI Clerk JA Backlog Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 07 August 2026 to 27 August 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 16 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their SBI Clerk JA Backlog Pre Admit Card 2026 from the link

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 August 2026
  • Last Date : 27 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 August 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 16 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 09 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

What is SBI Clerk JA Backlog Pre Admit Card 2026?

SBI Clerk JA Backlog Pre Admit Card 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 27 August 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://bank.sbi/

How to download admit card?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
